title: Empty circular waveguide, radius 10 mm, 30 mm long, on an unstructured mesh: TE11 transmission
source: TE11 propagation in a circular waveguide, S21 = exp(−jβL) with β = √(k0² − (x'₁₁/a)²), x'₁₁ = 1.841183781340659 the first zero of J₁' (M. Abramowitz, I. A. Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions, 1964, Table 9.5; D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.4)

quantities.reason: 3 mm tetrahedra, those on the wall curved: +0.03° over 30 mm near cut-off (λg = 52 mm); flat facets inscribed in the wall would narrow the guide and raise its cut-off, +2.5°
lossless: power is conserved; |S21| moves only by the small reflection
the exact Bessel modes at the ports against the curved cross-section: 4e-5 (3e-3 with flat facets)
as at 10.5 GHz, farther from cut-off (λg = 29 mm): +0.06°
